problem: Daily Brain learning success measured >100% by mixing all-status linked actions with done-only action denominator.
root_cause: The view counts any non-null outcome_id over all powerhouse_sales_actions for the numerator but only status=done for denominator. Empty done population is incorrectly declared 100% covered.

evidence.production_readback: 2026-10-22 read-only Supabase queries and existing issue #4198; no tenant PII copied

remediation: Replace the same invoker-security view in a bounded migration using same-population counts, null for zero completed actions, [0,1] invariant and retained service-only ACL.
prevention: All autonomous agents must validate denominator/numerator cohort parity before declaring coverage green.
Treat null/no observed done actions as UNPROVEN, never as automatic 100% success.
Regression-test cross-status linked outcomes and zero done actions; fail closed when a ratio is >1.
Reuse the existing Brain fingerprint, learner, scheduler and ONE authority; do not invent another metric/queue.
Promote only after exact-head Required CI, CodeQL, approved provider preview, protected merge and read-only production readback.
